how_its_made:
Uses self passport & celo network & AI in da box. 

World Improvement Proposals - Scan your passport and begin decentralized delegated democaracy today

We use Self passports to ensure participants are country level scanned and they can participate in game of proposing & evaluating ideas to improve world, peace and prosperity.

Quadratic system applies to same country citizens evaluating each other. 

Cubic for cross-country voting 

Every country get's own token and DAO! 

AI agents to delegate to included! 


First one to join becomes country millionaire! 

Uses self passport & celo network & AI in da box. 

Smart contracts  WIP.sol acts as erc1155 where each token represents a voting day. 

Those who verified their passport get daily supply that is spendable next day after claiming, in order to receive it, proposers must submit a vote themself. 

For each country a DAO is launched and every time someone votes for your proposal - you get a tokens for your country DAO. 

On frontend part you can delegate process to AI agent or play fun game of swiping left/right/up cards with ideas.
